newsitem.title: USA: Northeast Utilities named in holder suit.
newsitem.headline: Northeast Utilities named in holder suit.

text.p: A shareholder lawsuit seeking class action status has been filed against Northeast Utilities and its chairman and chief executive officer, Bernard Fox, the law firms representing plaintiffs said on Monday.

The law firms, Milberg Weiss Bershad Hynes & Lerach LLP and R. Bartley Halloran PC, said the complaint alleges that Northeast Utlities and Fox, among other things, misrepresented material information concerning the company's "Performance Enhancement Programs."
The programs were purportedly designed to remedy serious safety problems at the company's nuclear power plants, the law firms said.

The lawsuit alleges that because of the issuance of a series of false and misleading statements concerning the program and other matters regarding the safety of the nuclear facilities, the price of the company's securities was artificially inflated.
The firms said the lawsuit was filed on behalf of buyers of Northeast Utlties securities betweeen March 18, 1994 and April 5, 1996.
The firms said that plaintiffs seek to recover damages.
Last week, Northeast Utilities said that Fox planned to retire in the second half of the year and that its board was commencing a searh for a successor.
